reviewItem.question: For "Copy annotations from Ingress or Gateway to the Certificate: We've added a new configuration option to the cert-manager controller: `--extra-certificate-annota…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds a new controller option, --extra-certificate-annotations. It lets you list annotation keys to copy from an Ingress or Gateway resource to the Certificate created from it.
